svg.aria-label: BLIP-VQA: the prompt cut into noun phrases, one yes chance per question, multiplied, with the equation in coloured terms
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: BLIP-VQA: how one render and one prompt become one number, on a cat and a dog
the same render goes in for every question
The same line as an equation: each coloured piece is one box above
Numbers: tables/t2i-compbench.md, our toy "a cat and a dog" seed 9 render scored by the T2I-CompBench code at commit 4aa4042. Recomputed here: 0.9566 times 0.6428 = 0.6149.

Source for the method: T2I-CompBench++ paper page 6 ("we take the probability of answering yes as the score for a question ... multiplying"). The 480 px and the spaCy step are from the review protocol.
